query:
-- Strip CDATA wrapper from URLs
UPDATE news_items 
SET url = REGEXP_REPLACE(url, '<!\\[CDATA\\[(.+)\\]\\]>', '\\1')
WHERE url LIKE '%<![CDATA[%';

-- Strip ?f=rss tracking parameter
UPDATE news_items 
SET url = REPLACE(url, '?f=rss', '')
WHERE url LIKE '%?f=rss';
